name: moodle-mcp
description: Moodle MCP server for students. A Model Context Protocol MCP server that gives AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor read only access to Moodle courses: assignments, due dates, grades, announcements and course content.

tools.name: get_my_courses
tools.description: Lists your current courses with the ID other tools take as course_id. Hides finished and hidden courses.

tools.name: get_upcoming_due_dates
tools.description: Lists up to 50 items due in the next 60 days across your courses that still need action, soonest first, with the course name and due date. Plain course events such as 'Course starts' and 'Course ends' are left out because there is nothing to do about them.

parameters.name: course_ids
parameters.description: Course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the list. Leave out to cover all current courses.

tools.name: get_overdue
tools.description: Lists past due items from the last 45 days that still need action, with the course name and the date each was due.

parameters.name: course_ids
parameters.description: Course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the list. Leave out to cover all current courses.

tools.name: get_todo
tools.description: One digest for what to do next across your courses: overdue work, work due soon, assignments with no due date, and the latest announcement subjects, each with the course name and due date. Submission status comes from the assignment list and the calendar adds quizzes and other activities.

parameters.name: course_ids
parameters.description: Course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the digest. Leave out to cover all current courses.

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: How many days ahead to look. Default 14.

parameters.name: overdue_days
parameters.description: How many days back to include overdue work. Default 14.

tools.name: get_assignments
tools.description: Lists up to 25 assignments for one course with due dates and submission status: not submitted, draft, submitted or graded.

tools.name: get_missing_work
tools.description: Lists the assignments in your courses that you have not handed in yet, with the course name and the due date. Drafts that were never handed in are included, and work that was already handed in or graded is left out. Up to 25 assignments in each course are checked and the list holds up to 50 items.

parameters.name: course_ids
parameters.description: Course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the list. Leave out to cover all current courses.

tools.name: get_my_grades
tools.description: Shows the posted overall grade for every current course, or "no grade posted yet".

tools.name: get_course_grade_items
tools.description: Lists every graded item for one course with the mark and percentage, including the course total when there is one.

tools.name: get_course_content
tools.description: Lists the sections of one course, such as weeks or topics, with up to 40 activities in each, such as pages, quizzes and forums. Each activity shows its intro text when there is one, such as assignment instructions, label text or a page summary. Each file shows its name and a link with your key removed, ready for get_file.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Downloads one course file resource, such as a PDF, slide deck or handout, from its file_url. Plain text and HTML files come back as readable text. A PDF with readable text comes back as text, and a PDF with no extractable text comes back with its file name, a link with your key removed and a note to open it in Moodle. Any other file type is not supported and comes back with its file name, a link with your key removed and a note that only plain text, HTML and PDF are supported, with a note to open it in Moodle. Only a link on your school's Moodle site is downloaded, so your key is never sent to another server.

parameters.name: file_url
parameters.description: URL of the course file to download. Use the link from get_course_content.

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Lists the latest news forum posts with subject, course name and text, up to 5 posts from each of up to 10 news forums. A course or forum the school server will not open is left out and the rest still shows.

parameters.name: course_ids
parameters.description: Course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the search. Leave out to cover all current courses.
